## SCREEN 6: Vellum
**Product:** Chroma Quote Workbench — Module: Verdant

**Description:** Offers available discounts before premium calculation.

**Fields:**

| Label | Input Type | Mandatory | Default Value | Notes |
|-------|-----------|-----------|--------------|-------|
| Bundle with Home Policy | checkbox | No | unchecked | Optional discount |
| Paperless Billing | checkbox | No | unchecked | Optional discount |
| Good Student Discount | checkbox | No | unchecked | Optional discount |

**Buttons:**

| Caption | Action | Navigates To |
|---------|--------|--------------|
| Back | Return to previous screen | Screen 5: Umbra |
| Next | Submit and proceed | Screen 7: Furrow |

**Quote Text:** "Vellum keeps what paper forgets."  
**Quote Styling:** underlined, colour: #22945E

**Rules:**
- Bundle with Home Policy is optional; defaults to unchecked.
- Paperless Billing is optional; defaults to unchecked.
- Good Student Discount is optional; defaults to unchecked.
- No validation rules are specified; user may select any combination of discounts.
